commands.name: AcceptInventoryProposal
input: selected target ids or all eligible
steps: outside lock display exact source evidence reference, target partition and proposed effects
inside one UoW re-read proposal/targets and every owning Inventory projection/dependency
reject stale/incompatible target rather than coercing; material final decisions require explicit confirmation
insert one receipt and optional batch; dispatch each target to its owning Inventory mutation reducer without nested commit/receipt
append one independent lifecycle/result event per accepted target
transition proposal accepted only for exact accepted scope; preserve independently rejected/deferred partitions as separate dispositions when applicable
rebuild projections/audit and commit
rules: communication evidence never becomes authority by itself
no message body copied into Inventory

commands.name: RejectInventoryProposal
steps: inside UoW verify exact pending proposal
insert receipt; transition rejected and audit source/target refs
commit
commands.rule: rejection mutates no Inventory lifecycle entity

commands.name: AcceptInventoryBulkAction
steps: inside one UoW revalidate all intended eligible targets and exact material fingerprint
if any intended target changed or became incompatible abort whole selected mutation
insert receipt and inventory_lifecycle_batch
append one independently addressable lifecycle event/result per target
rebuild each projection, audit batch+targets and commit
rules: atomic across selected compatible scope
correcting one later target does not affect other batch members

commands.name: CorrectInventoryEvidence
steps: outside lock classify correction type: false event, relationship correction, alias correction, material submitted correction, or genuine later development
reject genuine later development from correction path
inside UoW prove exact disputed fact and all affected dependencies
insert receipt and append targeted correction/supersession event; never update/delete original evidence
rebuild only affected current projections and attention
if submitted Fault Tag membership materially changes return REPLACEMENT_REQUIRED rather than mutating it
audit original/correction/result refs and commit
rules: identity-bearing entities never replaced by relationship correction
Task outcome correction remains upstream LLD-05

commands.name: HardDeleteUntouchedInventoryDraft
steps: inside UoW rerun complete dependency classification and require CLEAR
insert receipt
delete only exact untouched draft-owned rows in FK-safe order; never cascade independently surviving entities or exported artifacts
append minimized non-reconstructable deletion audit/result refs and commit
rules: allocator values are never reused
hard deletion is correction for genuinely untouched drafts only, not ordinary history cleanup

pure_preview_queries.name: PreviewInventoryBulkAction
pure_preview_queries.rule: side-effect-free stable-Snapshot partition; creates no command receipt, audit or lifecycle evidence

pure_preview_queries.name: PreviewInventoryHardDelete
pure_preview_queries.rule: side-effect-free dependency classification; creates no deletion, receipt or audit evidence

InventoryTaskDependencyProvider: task hard delete is BLOCKED by accepted allocation history that is not untouched draft-safe, any physical consequence, or other protected Inventory lifecycle evidence
retry preview exposes only current eligible planning relationships selected by operator

retry apply runs in caller LLD-05 UoW and may create new planning allocation/Need relationship references only when unit is not contradictory; it never copies installed/removed/return/Fault Tag/warehouse history
InventoryProposalTargetService: LLD-09 supplies exact evidence/proposal context and one outer UoW when orchestrated
LLD-07 revalidates current lifecycle and appends owned events only

proposal_acceptance_v1: accept only the two typed owner actions pinned by INVENTORY_PROPOSAL_TARGET_V1
warehouse_received reuses exact Fault Tag membership receipt reducer in the caller UoW
warehouse_final_decision requires material_final risk and explicit_confirmation=true before any mutation
unsupported proposal kinds/actions fail DEPENDENCY_INDETERMINATE and leave proposal/Inventory unchanged
Beta 1.0 accepts the complete proposal target set atomically; partial selected scope fails DEPENDENCY_INDETERMINATE because target-level dispositions are not persisted by the current schema

bulk_action_contract_v1.target: fault_tag_membership_id + expected_revision; missing revision remains visible as missing_input in preview

context.reason_code: bounded string required only for warehouse_reject
context.explicit_confirmation: required true at commit for warehouse_accept and warehouse_reject

bulk_action_contract_v1.acceptance: AcceptInventoryBulkAction accepts exactly the eligible target identities/revisions returned by the reviewed preview fingerprint; any drift aborts the whole selected scope.

rules: replacement_kind/replacement_id are both null for suppression or both non-null
replacement_kind in rma|spare_part_unit|device_part_unit
target Spare Part Unit must already exist with origin_rma_id null
origin_rma_id must identify an existing RMA
the immutable spare_part_unit_id, LSU/local tracking id, creation_origin, BOM/serial and prior lifecycle history never change
adoption is provenance only and never creates rma_direct_inbound_units or claims physical receipt
append one spare_part_lifecycle_events correction event and advance only the Spare Part Unit current projection revision/current provenance

physical_consequence.rule: Beta 1.0 generic correction supports append-only reinterpretation only when the typed physical unit relationship set remains unchanged; material relationship rewrites fail CORRECTION_TARGET_INVALID and submitted Fault Tag consumption requires separate replacement workflow.

genuine_later_development.behavior: no mutation; fail CORRECTION_TARGET_INVALID and route to normal lifecycle command

correction_dispatch_contract_v1.transaction: one CorrectInventoryEvidence receipt/UoW dispatches directly to raw LLD-07 owner reducers; public correction services are never nested
correction_dispatch_contract_v1.response: InventoryMutationResultV1 with only owner result refs/revisions
correction_dispatch_contract_v1.audit: owner audit plus inventory.evidence.corrected.v1 in the same UoW

rules: target_event_id is UUID|null
result_id is UUID
reason_category is bounded normalized operator reason
unknown fields reject
no communication body, provider text, or source payload is copied into audit
